sample_unit: annotated text snippets from urology doctors' notes
unlisted_practices: Using locally deployed open source LLMs for data protection compliance in tumor documentation
Few-shot prompting with examples (including from other medical domains) to improve information extraction
Selecting mid-sized models (7-12B parameters) to balance performance and resource efficiency

screen.reason: Evaluates 11 open-source LLMs on German urology clinical notes across three tumor documentation tasks using different few-shot prompting strategies on a benchmark dataset.
